replacements.old: Return `(batch,6)`: normalised mean RGB from the upper half, followed by a one-hot word match. `templates` contains the three word regions and optionally a final blank region. Compare mean squared pixel error in the lower half; a blank match contributes zeros to the last three columns.
replacements.new:
Return `(batch, 6)` for `images: [batch, H, W, 3]` with even H and nonnegative RGB pixels. Average the upper half over height and width to obtain `rgb: [batch, 3]`, then divide by `maximum(rgb.sum(-1, keepdims=True), 1e-12)`. This is **sum normalization (L1 for nonnegative RGB)**, distinct from the preceding L2 `normalise_rows`: `[0.6, 0.8, 0]` becomes `[3/7, 4/7, 0]`; all-zero RGB stays zero.

`templates` has shape `[3, H/2, W, 3]`, or `[4, H/2, W, 3]` when the last entry is the blank region. Compare lower-half mean squared pixel error over height, width and RGB, and use the first minimum on a tie. Template indices 0–2 produce the corresponding three-column one-hot word match; optional index 3 produces `[0, 0, 0]`. Concatenate the sum-normalized RGB and word channels.

rationale: GV-05: distinguish sum-normalized RGB from L2, specify zero/blank behavior and exact shapes; immediate CPU oracle strengthened separately.
